# Datasets in the GMCI Collection {.unnumbered}

The table below provides an overview of all datasets currently included in the [GMCI collection](https://zenodo.org/communities/mardigmci). The entries may be interactively filtered by selecting the desired attributes in the column headers. For detailed documentation of an individual dataset, the corresponding name links directly to its record on Zenodo.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(DT)

column_names <- c("Name", "Size of Collection", "Sample Size", "Dimension", "Task", "Data Type", "Dataset Scope", "Ground Truth", "Temporal Structure", "License", "Missing Values")

############################################################################
# format datasets

colnames(d) <- column_names
datasets <- as.data.frame(d)
datasets$`Size of Collection` <- as.numeric(datasets$`Size of Collection`)
for (i in 1:ncol(datasets)) {
  if (i %in% 2:4) {
    datasets[, i] <- as.numeric(datasets[, i])
  }
  else {
    datasets[, i] <- as.factor(datasets[, i])
  }
}
row.names(datasets) <- NULL


############################################################################
# provide datasets as clickable table

datatable(
  datasets,
  filter = "top",
  escape = FALSE,   # allow HTML in cells
  options = list(pageLength = 25)
)
```

# Custom Online Data Extraction {.unnumbered}

Many application domains present problems in which graphical modeling provides a statistical framework for addressing fundamental questions about underlying relationships. To support researchers engaged in custom data extraction, we provide below a selection of representative areas together with links to relevant resources. Researchers who derive new datasets through such extraction or post‑processing are encouraged to contribute their finalized materials to our [Zenodo community](https://zenodo.org/communities/mardigmci).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

::: {.callout-note collapse="false" title="Health Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   Sugar consumption on diabetes risk

-   Genetic predisposition to obesity on cardiovascular disease

-   Early administration of vasopressors might improve survival rates in ICU patients with septic shock

| Source | License | Data Provided |
|----|----|----|
| [MIMIC-IV](https://physionet.org/content/mimiciv/2.2/) (see also [PhysionNet](https://physionet.org/)) | Credential Health Data License 1.5.0 (training required; [License](https://physionet.org/content/mimiciv/view-license/2.2/)) | Critical care data for over 40,000 patients admitted to intensive care units at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. |
| [National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/default.aspx) | Statistical reporting and analysis only ([License](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html)) | Health of 5,000 adults and children in the US: food, drinks, supplements, nutrients, blood tests. |
| [UK Biobank](https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/) | Need application and ethics approval ([License](https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/media/hbonv55a/code-of-conduct-ukbb-nov-2020.pdf)) | [Genetic and health information from half a million UK participants](https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/enable-your-research/about-our-data): Imaging, Genetics, Health linkages, Biomarkers, Activity monitor, Questionnaires, Blood samples |
| Cardiology: [MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database](https://www.physionet.org/content/mitdb/1.0.0/) (see also [PhysionNet](https://physionet.org/)) | ODC-By ([License](https://www.physionet.org/content/mitdb/view-license/1.0.0/)) | 48 half-hour excerpts of two-channel ambulatory ECG recordings, obtained from 47 subjects. |
| Neurology: [OpenNEURO](https://openneuro.org/) | CCO ([License](https://docs.openneuro.org/faq)) | MRI, PET, EEG, iEEG, MEG [datasets](https://openneuro.org/search) |
| Epidemiology: JH [Coronavirus Resource Center](https://coronavirus.jhu.edu/) | CC BY 4.0 ([License](https://github.com/CSSEGISandData/COVID-19)) | Global COVID-19 case counts, deaths, and recoveries at the country and state/province level, updated throughout the pandemic |
:::
